title: The Coming of Sayyidina Imam Mahdi (a) & the Secret of Imam Husayn (r)
body:
Man lam yakun lahu imaam fa imaamahu 'sh-Shaytan, "Who doesn't have a guide, his imaam is Shaytan.”
Alhamdulillah, radiynaa kullu ’l-ummam, we are accepting of all nations. Laa nufarriqu bayna ahadin, "We
make no distinction between any” (al-Baqara, 2:285). Kalaamullah, Allah’s Words.
Don’t make khilaaf, dispute among imaams. Don’t leave them to be unhappy from you. Make the imaam
happy with you or else it is so difficult, all fitnah. Shaytan is running here and there saying, “O let me go here.
O there’s another one; let me go there. O and another one!” Now Shaytan is surprised; he’s left in amazement.
May Allah protect us from falling into the hands of an oppressor. Don’t be a zhaaliman, oppressor or
mazhlooman, the oppressed. Soon inshaa-Allah the order will come down from Heavens, and as soon as He
says, “Come out!” he will appear. Imam Mahdi (a) looks at the order coming from above. A command from
Heavens given to him: “Come out! You’ve been dressed power on yourself; no one can touch you.” If anything
touches him, like this (he’ll be taken away).
When he is making takbeer technology will be finished: ferries won’t be able to move and every machine that
gives so much courage to people for that reason will be closed down. Their airplanes won’t fly, their tanks,
artillery and rockets won’t move! Only swords, and nothing else. Teknolojinin kafasini kesecek tekbir, his

takbeer will cut off the head of technology!
They are saying, for example, that Syria closed its sky so that no one can see or hear such things, finished. If
technologists are using that very small power, when the time comes they won’t be able to do anything with all
that they know, finished; only swords.
Imam Sayyidina Mahdi (a) will come with one firqa, division, all on horses. Saahib az-Zamaan making his
horse like this (Mawlana Shaykh gesturing take-off), and that will be enough--no need for taka tuka taka tuka
(horses running), it will fly, and behind him will be 12,000 chosen ones! If looking at them with such look,
that person may fall down dead. Havârik, wonders! Everything that operates with technology will finish:
technology will be under the feet of his horse! Allahu, Allahu Akbaru ‘l-Akbar.
Yaa Rabbee! We are asking to reach those holy days that no prophet was ever given such an authority. It
should only be for Mahdi (a) to clean dunya and not leave anyone against Islam. Like take-off, then coming
down; any place they land, they only make their horses fly up for one minute and come down in one minute.
In black, they are shouting. If anyone hears them, they will say, “Thunder! The world is thundering but there
aren’t any clouds! How?” They will make woojjj, woojjj, woojjj with their swords, lightning, and finished. A
miraculous power will be granted for him to use, a power which Rasoolullah (s) never used; it is for Sayyidina
Mahdi (a). Allah yaa Rabbee, tawbah yaa Rabbee, amaan yaa Rabbee. This is coming! This is coming!
••••••• ••••• •••••••• •••••
wa khaaba kullu jabbarin `aneed. and disappointed, [therefore], was every obstinate tyrant. (Ibrahim, 14:15)
Everyone claiming that he is the first, or that he is the best or most powerful, his head will be thrown away!
The fuqaraa, poor, and the du`afa, weak, will be with Mahdi (a). Jabaabira, tyrants, Allah Allah, Allah
yudaafi`a, He will be defending the believers. If they aren’t believing, they will be taken away also. “Hajji,
come. All of those people have passed away with their homes and castles. What shall we do?”
I am looking to see which one should be for Saahib az-Zamaan. Ooooh (Mawlana Shaykh in amazement)! In
Germany there was this one tower, a castle which belonged to an emperor. Just like it, but he is not in need
for that. He may leave his own things in it, but in a split second, that night he will make a castle. It will be a
building for Saahib al-`Asr--a castle, not a palace. Castle! If all Mankind tries to make such a castle, they can’t

do it. Allahu Akbar! And Mahdi, Saahib az-Zamaan, he will be on his horse bayna ‘l-samaa wa ‘l-`ard,
between Heavens and Earth. He will move (upward in ascension), then he will stop, jump to the castle and
rule!
But now people are not interested in such things. All of them are occupied for dunya, for themselves. And
dunya is saying, “I am not with anyone. I am here but you are going. Don’t try to reach to me, no, but try to be
from those people whom on the Last Day, will be called as ‘Paradise People,’ entering jannat al-`aliyya, fee
jannat al-firdaws, the highest Heaven, in Jannat al-Firdaws.” Allah jalla jalaaluhu, jallat `azhamatuhu.
We are not patient people; we are asking everything to be quickly. We are weak ones. And astaghfirullah,
those tyrants are making zhulm, oppression, laa hadd wa laa yanal zhulm min an-naas kazaa, with no limits,
and not including oppression from the people as well. We are waiting for that one who can take the hands of
believers, Muslims, Ummatu Muhammad (s); to take them away, to save them and to destroy everything
from kufr!
Sayyidina Hussayn (r) came there in the event of Karbala; the order came, “Stop! Now leave what is
happening for Us.” He was there with the Holy Family (a), and a group of fadaaiyoon came, sacrificing
themselves. Then the soldiers of Yazid approached. I am saying, what do you think? Ibnu Nabee (s), the Son
of Prophet to be slaughtered? Do you think that he was slaughtered like a sacrificial ram? Seventy kings of
jinns surrounded them, ever ready, so the moment they were touched, they immediately took him and
replaced him with a duplicate. They slaughtered that one and people stood up!
O, Allah Almighty is trying His servants! Sayyidina Hussayn (r) was taken to his Grandfather’s (s) maqaam.
There are so many things that no one knows now. Why did the jinn come there? To make a show? Hashaa!
••••••••• ••••••• ••••••
wa lakin shubbiha lahum. But [another] was made to resemble him to them. (an-Nisa, 4:157)
That is Holy Qur’an’s ayatul-kareemah. They were thinking that they slaughtered (him) just as they thought
they had caught Jesus Christ, putting him on the cross. That never happened! Wahid, “one” was dressed in
his outer appearance as Sayyidina `Isa (a) and another one also looking like Sayyidina Hussayn (r), so harm
never touched them. Haasha! Haasha thumma kallaa!

But people must cry on him. They must cry for Sayyidina Hussayn (r). He is going to make intercession for
everyone who is crying for him also. He is not asking to make divisions in the ummah, no. There is one! Such
secret events (took place) that awliyaaullah were also ready there. But no one is speaking. Now waqt, time is
over.
Therefore, we can only speak one drop from an ocean, no more. Inshaa-Allah we hope everything we are
doing is for Allah, not for dunya. Whoever is making any action without thinking, without knowing, they are
going to be taken away. Ooooh, thousands and thousands of people writing for Karbala. But if they are
looking from outside, they can’t look inside.
Inshaa-Allah you should be happy with Sayyidina al-Mahdi (a) and you must make du`a for a weak servant.
For seventy years I am waiting, making myself ready to salute when he comes. For seventy years that I heard
about him, my heart was filled with love and service to him!
For every century, some people have been granted that authority to meet him, alayhi’ s-salaam. `Alaa
nabiyyina wa `alayhi ‘s-salaati wa ‘s-salaam. Alfu alf salaatu salaam `alaa habibillah wa nasli paaki rasool
hazrati Hussain, radiy ’Allahu`anhu wa yarda `alayhi s-salaam. Yaa Rabbee! Ij`alhum shufa`a lanaa yawma
’z-zihaam, to be a savior for us!
Fatihah.
